summary: Lesma is a self-hosted pastebin service designed to store and share text snippets. It provides interfaces for both web browsers and command-line tools to upload and retrieve content. The application is built using Rust and packaged via Docker.
goodFor: This is suitable for individuals or teams looking for a lightweight, self-hosted text sharing utility that integrates with shell scripts and terminals.
watchOut: With very low repository activity and an unrated maintenance status, you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack timely updates. It also competes in a crowded category with much more mature alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised Rust application, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination. Depending on how persistence is configured, you may also need to attach a volume for data storage.
